name: Vent Torch
enabledDescription: Still pressurised. The bore seal looks welded shut from the inside.
disabledDescription: Dead igniter.

name: Igniter Patch
enabledDescription: Fitted. Lights on the first strike.
disabledDescription: Nothing to fit it to yet.

name: Welding Gear
enabledDescription: You can now cut the bore seal safely.
disabledDescription: Safety first :)

name: Insulated Cold Gear
enabledDescription: The ice shelf won't kill you now.
disabledDescription: Cracked seals.

name: Coolant System Manifest
enabledDescription: Cross-references with Crael's refinery schematics. Someone was planning something.
disabledDescription: Pressure-locked. Only released down here.

name: Garrison ID Badge
enabledDescription: Chip intact. Biometric readers should accept it.
disabledDescription: Fried authentication chip.

name: Field Chip Reader
enabledDescription: Badge re-initialised. It'll pass a scanner.
disabledDescription: No badge loaded.

name: Armoury Keycard
enabledDescription: Authenticated. The weapons cache will cycle open.
disabledDescription: Handshake fails without a chip reader.

name: Evacuation Orders
enabledDescription: Final orders, counter-signed. The command block was left on manual release.
disabledDescription: Slipped under the gate. Need command block access to retrieve it.

name: Hazard Clearance Suit
enabledDescription: Sealed and pressurised. Presso's flats won't touch you.
disabledDescription: Locked in the weapons cache.

name: Hydraulic Debris Cutter
enabledDescription: The ring debris blocking the outcrop can be cleared.
disabledDescription: Dry hydraulic reservoir.

name: Signal Decoder
enabledDescription: Salvaged from the outcrop. Needs a frequency reference to lock on.
disabledDescription: Blocked by debris.

name: Frequency Spool
enabledDescription: Decoder locked on. The refinery ping is readable.
disabledDescription: No decoder to feed it into.

name: Smelter Access Rod
enabledDescription: The coolant routing checks out. The lower bay gate will cycle.
disabledDescription: Gate mechanism needs the coolant lines read first.

name: Broadcast Room Access Code
enabledDescription: Ping source isolated. The broadcast room door responds.
disabledDescription: Needs the lower bay cleared first.

name: Transmission Fragment
enabledDescription: A colonial distress transmission. The Presso rig's autonomous systems are keyed to this signal.
disabledDescription: Terminal locked.

name: Fuel Line Connector
enabledDescription: Pressure-rated. Fits the drill arm's fuel cutoff valve.
disabledDescription: Nothing survives the flats without a rated suit.

name: Drill Arm Shutoff Procedure
enabledDescription: Full autonomous cycle override. With the connector fitted, the arms can be stopped safely.
disabledDescription: Shaft sealed — autonomous systems never received the shutdown signal.

name: Drill Arm Shutoff Code
enabledDescription: Arms stopped. The drill bay is still.
disabledDescription: Need the procedure and the connector first.

name: Hyperdrive Evacuation Ship
enabledDescription: Fuelled and intact. It was always meant to be found last. You can leave.
disabledDescription: Arms still cycling. You won't survive getting close.
